as_told.title: MJ-12 documents created by James Jesus Angleton

plain: The so-called Majestic 12, or MJ-12, documents are papers that describe a secret group said to have handled UFO matters for the US government, and Jesse Michels suggests they may have been pushed out, or even made, by James Jesus Angleton, a longtime counterintelligence officer at the CIA, the US spy agency. Michels raises this himself on three episodes, without naming a source, and grows firmer each time: first as a maybe, then as something he has heard and does not know is true, and finally as his personal belief that Angleton created many of the documents in the 1980s and 90s, mainly to catch Soviet spies. If so, the papers would be a spy trap rather than a window on real UFO secrets.
